description: This file defines the AdoNetGatewayListProvider class which implements IGatewayListProvider. It manages retrieving a list of gateways asynchronously for Orleans clustering using ADO.NET, and includes logging and configuration handling.

classes.name: AdoNetGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements gateway list provisioning using ADO.NET for Orleans clustering, supports async initialization and retrieval of gateway URIs, with logging support.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the provider by creating the Orleans queries interface asynchronously.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns a list of active gateway URIs; logs the process and handles exceptions.
